summary: Security update for the Linux Kernel
details:
The SUSE Linux Enterprise 16.0 kernel was updated to fix various security issues:

The following security issues were fixed:

- CVE-2026-31731: thermal: core: Address thermal zone removal races with resume (bsc#1264042).
- CVE-2026-46028: crypto: algif_aead - snapshot IV for async AEAD requests (bsc#1267430).
- CVE-2026-53108: powerpc/64s: Fix unmap race with PMD migration entries (bsc#1269561).
- CVE-2026-63830: net: skmsg: preserve sg.copy across SG transforms (bsc#1272178).
- CVE-2026-64012: net/sched: sch_sfb: Replace direct dequeue call with peek and qdisc_dequeue_peeked (bsc#1273764).
- CVE-2026-64058: netfs: Fix netfs_read_folio() to wait on writeback (bsc#1272898).
- CVE-2026-64060: netfs: Fix leak of request in netfs_write_begin() error handling (bsc#1272901).
- CVE-2026-64062: netfs: Fix potential deadlock in write-through mode (bsc#1272952).
- CVE-2026-64063: netfs: Fix streaming write being overwritten (bsc#1272955).
- CVE-2026-64064: netfs: Fix netfs_invalidate_folio() to clear dirty bit if all changes gone (bsc#1272956).
- CVE-2026-64068: netfs: Fix missing locking around retry adding new subreqs (bsc#1272509).
- CVE-2026-64116: ipv6: ioam: add NULL check for idev in ipv6_hop_ioam() (bsc#1273751).
- CVE-2026-64280: fpga: dfl-afu: validate DMA mapping length in afu_dma_map_region() (bsc#1273599).
- CVE-2026-64424: netpoll: fix a use-after-free on shutdown path (bsc#1274256).
- CVE-2026-64428: gpio: sch: use raw_spinlock_t in the irq startup path (bsc#1274039).
- CVE-2026-64435: audit: Fix data races of skb_queue_len() readers on audit_queue (bsc#1274080).
- CVE-2026-64461: PCI: mediatek: Fix IRQ domain leak when port fails to enable (bsc#1273865).
- CVE-2026-68233: drm/vc4: Shut down BO cache timer before teardown (bsc#1275644).
- CVE-2026-68241: drm/i915/mst: limit DP MST ESI service loop (bsc#1275785).
- CVE-2026-68242: drm/i915/gt: Fix NULL deref on sched_engine alloc failure (bsc#1275786).
- CVE-2026-68323: tipc: serialize udp bearer replicast list updates (bsc#1274653).
- CVE-2026-72015: fs/resctrl: Fix double-add of pseudo-locked region's RMID to free list (bsc#1276791).
- CVE-2026-72040: ipmi: fix refcount leak in i_ipmi_request() (bsc#1276836).
- CVE-2026-72041: espintcp: use sk_msg_free_partial to fix partial send (bsc#1275510).
- CVE-2026-72081: scsi: elx: efct: Fix I/O leak on unsupported additional CDB (bsc#1277174).
- CVE-2026-72110: bpf,fork: wipe ->bpf_storage before bailouts that access it (bsc#1277357).
- CVE-2026-72172: mm/mm_init: fix uninitialized struct pages for ZONE_DEVICE (bsc#1277691).
- CVE-2026-72174: fs/proc/task_mmu: fix hugetlb self-deadlock in pagemap_scan_pte_hole() (bsc#1277695).
- CVE-2026-72212: mm/memory_hotplug: fix incorrect altmap passing in error path (bsc#1277602).
- CVE-2026-72213: mm/hugetlb: fix hugetlb cgroup rsvd charge/uncharge mismatch (bsc#1277603).
- CVE-2026-72236: s390/perf_cpum_cf: Add missing array_index_nospec() to __hw_perf_event_init() (bsc#1277614).
- CVE-2026-72250: netfilter: nf_conntrack_reasm: guard mac_header adjustment after IPv6 defrag (bsc#1277663).
- CVE-2026-72253: netfilter: nf_conntrack_sip: validate skb_dst() before accessing it (bsc#1277665).
- CVE-2026-72305: VDUSE: avoid leaking information to userspace (bsc#1277747).
- CVE-2026-72319: ipvs: fix PMTU for GUE/GRE tunnel ICMP errors (bsc#1275964).
- CVE-2026-72355: netfs: Fix barriering when walking subrequest list (bsc#1276330).
- CVE-2026-72405: net: udp_tunnel: prevent double queueing in udp_tunnel_nic_device_sync (bsc#1278033).
- CVE-2026-72493: net: serialize netif_running() check in enqueue_to_backlog() (bsc#1276951).
- CVE-2026-74306: vfio/qat: fix f_pos race in qat_vf_resume_write() (bsc#1276907).
- CVE-2026-74312: vhost/vdpa: validate virtqueue index in mmap and fault paths (bsc#1276873).
- CVE-2026-74368: wifi: ath12k: fix memory leak in ath12k_wifi7_dp_rx_h_verify_tkip_mic() (bsc#1277103).
- CVE-2026-74379: dax/kmem: account for partial discontiguous resource upon removal (bsc#1278232).
- CVE-2026-74544: net/sched: cls_u32: validate offshift to prevent shift-out-of-bounds (bsc#1277894).
- CVE-2026-74578: crypto: algif_skcipher - force synchronous processing (bsc#1275564).
- CVE-2026-74583: net/sched: cls_route: fix fastmap use-after-free on filter (bsc#1277889).
- CVE-2026-74587: sctp: fix use-after-free of cached ASCONF chunk (bsc#1277821).
- CVE-2026-74611: tls: rx: restore msg_iter before TLS 1.3 optimistic retry (bsc#1277804).
- CVE-2026-74614: vsock/virtio: read virtqueues under worker locks (bsc#1277931).
- CVE-2026-74624: netfilter: nf_conntrack: defer invalid log until after unlock (bsc#1277599).
- CVE-2026-74715: bpf: Fix netns reference imbalance in conntrack kfuncs (bsc#1277890).
- CVE-2026-80572: Input: byd - synchronize timer deletion before freeing private data (bsc#1277338).
- CVE-2026-80579: fbdev: clear fb_info->mode before deleting a videomode (bsc#1277260).
- CVE-2026-80893: mm/hugetlb: fix swap entry corruption when clearing uffd-wp at fork() (bsc#1279706).
- CVE-2026-80977: net: skbuff: don't touch shared zerocopy state in skb_tx_error() (bsc#1280259).
- CVE-2026-89528: svcrdma: Reject Read lists that exceed the page budget (bsc#1280743).
- CVE-2026-89558: md/raid10: fix still_degraded being inverted in raid10_sync_request() (bsc#1280552).
- CVE-2026-89593: hugetlb: only adjust reservation during unmapping if mapcount is 0 (bsc#1280229).
- CVE-2026-89631: smb: client: reject a tree connect response whose byte count is too small (bsc#1280496).
- CVE-2026-89636: smb: client: clear ce->tgthint in free_tgts() (bsc#1281042).
- CVE-2026-89640: cifs: fix loff_t underflow in cifs_remap_file_range() when len == 0 (bsc#1280950).
- CVE-2026-89754: mm/pagewalk: fix stale walk->action escaping walk_pmd_range() (bsc#1280769).
- CVE-2026-89755: mm/migrate_device: clear stale mapping after freeing swapcache (bsc#1280770).
- CVE-2026-89778: isofs: fix out-of-bounds page array access on empty zisofs block (bsc#1280966).
- CVE-2026-89811: drm/amdkfd: Add TLB flush after MES queue eviction/suspension (bsc#1281144).
- CVE-2026-89987: mm/huge_memory: transfer the pmd dirty bit to the folio on zap (bsc#1281819).
- CVE-2026-90011: scsi: target: iscsi: Reserve a terminator byte for the login payload (bsc#1281280).
- CVE-2026-90283: hugetlbfs: release subpool on fill_super failure (bsc#1281771).
- CVE-2026-90289: drm/amd/display: Resize MST HDCP per-connector arrays to 32 (bsc#1281726).
- CVE-2026-93066: x86/mm/pat: Take cpa_lock around large-page collapse (bsc#1282274).
- CVE-2026-93134: printk: Fix possible console use-after-free (bsc#1281162).
- CVE-2026-93222: signal: avoid shared siginfo namespace rewrites (bsc#1282742).
- CVE-2026-93252: ocfs2: fix circular locking dependency in ocfs2_init_acl() (bsc#1282784).
- CVE-2026-93785: cifs: validate idmap key payload length (bsc#1282869).
- CVE-2026-93787: smb: client: bound dirent name against end of SMB response in cifs_filldir (bsc#1282932).
- CVE-2026-93798: btrfs: fix reloc root cleanup in merge_reloc_roots() (bsc#1282769).
- CVE-2026-93806: wifi: cfg80211: validate assoc response length before status and IE access (bsc#1283037).
- CVE-2026-97415: btrfs: tree-checker: validate names in ROOT_REF and ROOT_BACKREF (bsc#1282768).
- CVE-2026-97416: btrfs: balance: fix potential bg lookup failure in btrfs_may_alloc_data_chunk() (bsc#1282770).
- CVE-2026-97491: net/rds: Don't sleep inside rds_ib_conn_path_shutdown (bsc#1283142).
- CVE-2026-97533: x86/mm/pat: Acquire init_mm read lock on attribute changes to avoid UAF (bsc#1283454).
- CVE-2026-97554: smb: client: avoid using uninitialized SIDs in cifs_posix_to_fattr() (bsc#1283850).
- CVE-2026-97555: smb: client: fix heap overflow in DACL owner/group rewrite (bsc#1283851).
- CVE-2026-97556: smb: client: avoid leaking refcount when cifs_sb_tlink() fails (bsc#1283853).
- CVE-2026-97558: smb: client: fix cifsFileInfo reference leak in deferred close (bsc#1283855).
- CVE-2026-97559: smb: client: fail DACL rewrite when the new DACL exceeds 64K (bsc#1283856).
- CVE-2026-97561: smb: client: honor forceuid/forcegid when mapping SIDs to uid/gid (bsc#1283858).
- CVE-2026-97562: smb: client: pin DFS superblock in iterator callback (bsc#1283862).
- CVE-2026-97563: smb: client: reject out-of-bounds DataOffset in CIFSSMBRead() (bsc#1283877).
- CVE-2026-97564: smb: client: reject userspace cifs.idmap descriptions (bsc#1283946).
- CVE-2026-97942: x86/alternatives: Exclude text poking against change_page_attr() (bsc#1283153).
- CVE-2026-97943: x86/mm/pat: Acquire init_mm write lock on collapse to avoid UAF (bsc#1283158).
- CVE-2026-97945: x86/mm: Fix user-space data loss with MADV_FREE and THP (bsc#1283144).
- CVE-2026-98010: net/sched: drr: clamp quantum in change class (bsc#1283823).
- CVE-2026-98015: net/mlx5: E-Switch: fix use-after-free in mlx5_eswitch_termtbl_put (bsc#1283963).
- CVE-2026-98016: net/mlx5e: Fix use-after-free race in sample_restore_put() (bsc#1283894).
- CVE-2026-98041: bpf: Don't predict JMP32 pointer vs zero comparisons (bsc#1284064).
- CVE-2026-98077: netfilter: nf_conntrack_sip: fix OOB read in sip_skip_whitespace() (bsc#1283979).
- CVE-2026-98089: bonding: alb: fix uninitialized transport header access in alb_determine_nd() (bsc#1283936).
- CVE-2026-98125: smb/client: fix stale page cache in insert/collapse range (bsc#1283812).
- CVE-2026-98126: smb/client: validate new EOF for zero range (bsc#1283859).
- CVE-2026-98127: smb/client: validate new EOF for insert range (bsc#1283873).
- CVE-2026-98130: sctp: fix a TOCTOU race in SCTP_CMD_TIMER_START (bsc#1283835).
- CVE-2026-98167: smb: client: fix server->total_read for compound encrypted PDUs (bsc#1284422).
- CVE-2026-98169: smb: client: fix potential OOB read in smb3_enum_snapshots() (bsc#1284298).
- CVE-2026-98170: smb: client: fix OOB struct field reads in move_smb2_ea_to_cifs() (bsc#1284310).
- CVE-2026-98171: smb: client: fix next_buffer UAF and NextCommand bounds in compound PDUs (bsc#1284419).
- CVE-2026-98173: smb: client: fix use-after-free of iface in cifs_try_adding_channels() (bsc#1284415).
- CVE-2026-98174: smb: client: fix rlist race and missing initialization (bsc#1284412).
- CVE-2026-98175: smb: client: cancel reconnect work in clean_demultiplex_info() (bsc#1284312).
- CVE-2026-98216: IB/hfi1: Fix the PIO_CRED credit-return mmap (bsc#1284559).
- CVE-2026-98252: RDMA/core: fix refcount bug in iwpm_get_nlmsg_request() (bsc#1284581).
- CVE-2026-98253: RDMA/ucma: Serialize join and leave on copy_to_user failure (bsc#1284790).
- CVE-2026-98260: exec: Cleanup POSIX timers right after de_thread() (bsc#1284408).
- CVE-2026-98261: cifs: Fix server use-after-free in cifs_chan_skip_or_disable() (bsc#1284605).
- CVE-2026-98269: btrfs: abort transaction on failure to update inode for hole punching and reflinking (bsc#1284606).
- CVE-2026-98273: x86/kprobes: Fix crash when probing CS CALL instructions (bsc#1284462).
- CVE-2026-98323: RDMA/siw: Bound fragmented header copies by the remaining length (bsc#1284713).
- CVE-2026-98347: IB/IPoIB: Avoid restoring OPER_UP after multicast flush (bsc#1284295).
- CVE-2026-98352: kABI fix for RDMA/rtrs-clt: Fix CQ pool leak when connect is interrupted (bsc#1284647).
- CVE-2026-98354: RDMA/mad: Fix receive buffer leak when PKey enforcement fails (bsc#1284291).
- CVE-2026-98357: IB/isert: wait for deferred control PDU completions before releasing the connection (bsc#1284791).
- CVE-2026-98358: IB/iser: reject a remote invalidation of an unregistered direction (bsc#1284289).
- CVE-2026-98359: RDMA/core: Reject unregistering netdevs in ib_get_eth_speed (bsc#1284746).
- CVE-2026-98360: RDMA/rxe: insert mcg into mcg_tree only after rxe_mcast_add() succeeds (bsc#1284649).
- CVE-2026-98365: RDMA/rxe: Fix integer overflow in mr_check_range() leading to OOB access (bsc#1284288).
- CVE-2026-98366: RDMA/rxe: validate access flags before swapping the MR's PD (bsc#1284655).
- CVE-2026-98367: RDMA/siw: Clear association under lock if siw_qp_modify fails in siw_accept (bsc#1284424).
- CVE-2026-98432: ipv4: free inet_opt and ireq_opt after an RCU grace period (bsc#1285685).
- CVE-2026-99999: ipv4: validate checksum_start before completing checksum (bsc#1285684).

The following non security issues were fixed:

- ALSA: usb-audio: Apply IGNORE_CTL_ERROR quirk to all Audient devices (git-fixes).
- arm64/fpsimd: signal: Forbid non-streaming SVE payload on SME-only systems (git-fixes).
- arm64: cpufeature: Make PMUVer and PerfMon unsigned (git-fixes).
- arm64: errata: Add Cortex-A725 erratum 3821522 workaround (git-fixes) Enable workaround by default for aarch64.
- arm64: errata: Factor out broken AMU const counter cap (git-fixes) Enable this workaround by default for aarch64.
- arm64: errata: Workaround for SI L1 downstream coherency issue (git-fixes) Enable workaround by default for aarch64.
- arm64: irq: exclude the softirq stack switch from KCOV (git-fixes).
- ASoC: adau1372: allow sleepy powerdown GPIOs (git-fixes).
- ASoC: adau1372: fix invalid default state of output ASRC and DAC muxes (git-fixes).
- ASoC: amd: yc: Add DMI quirk for Acer Aspire Go 15 (AG15-21P) (stable-fixes).
- ASoC: cs42l52: Fix the NG Type Switch bit (git-fixes).
- ASoC: cs42l56: Put the Limiter Cushion control on the limiter register (git-fixes).
- ASoC: Intel: avs: Reset the stream unless it is already prepared (git-fixes).
- ASoC: max98371: Fix the Speaker DHT Min Volume bits (git-fixes).
- ASoC: nau8822: Fix the 128x oversampling switch bits (git-fixes).
- ASoC: pcm3168a: Fix the DAC zero flag polarity bit (git-fixes).
- ASoC: samsung: i2s: enable op_clk in probe to balance runtime PM (git-fixes).
- ASoC: SOF: ipc4-priv: Add kernel doc for fw_context_save of sof_ipc4_fw_data (stable-fixes).
- ASoC: SOF: ipc4/Intel: Add support for library restore firmware functionality (stable-fixes).
- ASoC: stm32: spdifrx: fix synchronization state check (git-fixes).
- ASoC: wm8978: Fix the 128x oversampling switch bits (git-fixes).
- Bluetooth: btintel: fix buffer over-read in btintel_hw_error() (git-fixes).
- Bluetooth: btintel: validate DDC record lengths (git-fixes).
- Bluetooth: btintel_pcie: Add shared HW reset for clean start (git-fixes).
- Bluetooth: btintel_pcie: fix plen overflow in btintel_pcie_recv_frame() (git-fixes).
- Bluetooth: btintel_pcie: fix TX descriptor bounds check (git-fixes).
- Bluetooth: btintel_pcie: reject oversized TX packets in send_frame() (git-fixes).
- Bluetooth: btintel_pcie: use managed IRQ teardown (git-fixes).
- Bluetooth: btusb: Add IMC Networks QCA9377 to quirks table (stable-fixes).
- Bluetooth: hci_conn: Lock parent access during enhanced SCO setup (git-fixes).
- Bluetooth: hci_core: free the HCI ID if naming fails (git-fixes).
- Bluetooth: hci_core: Serialize ACL scheduling with channel deletion (git-fixes).
- Bluetooth: hci_core: Serialize fragmented ISO packet queueing (git-fixes).
- Bluetooth: hci_sock: Serialize dead-device detachment (git-fixes).
- Bluetooth: hci_sync: don't drain cmd_sync backlog on unregister (git-fixes).
- Bluetooth: hci_sync: Fix inquiry cache use-after-free (git-fixes).
- Bluetooth: ISO: Reject concurrent BIS listener setup (git-fixes).
- Bluetooth: ISO: Serialize concurrent connect calls (git-fixes).
- Bluetooth: MGMT: Fix status of pending commands flushed on power off (git-fixes).
- Bluetooth: RFCOMM: Fix initial port reference race (git-fixes).
- Bluetooth: RFCOMM: Fix NULL tty_dev dereference in rfcomm_dev_shutdown (git-fixes).
- Bluetooth: RFCOMM: free the skb when the DLC has no owner (git-fixes).
- Bluetooth: SCO: serialise sco_conn lifetime against sco_recv_scodata() (git-fixes).
- crypto: ccp - Add support for PCI device 0x17D8 (jsc#PED-13872).
- Drivers: hv: Avoid infinite retry loop in init_vp_index() (git-fixes).
- Drivers: hv: Don't reset VMBus connection state on error/exit paths (git-fixes).
- Drivers: hv: vmbus: add VTL2 redirect connection ID (git-fixes).
- Drivers: hv: vmbus: fix typo "substract" in comment (git-fixes).

- drm/amdgpu/gfx6: fix firmware leak on teardown (stable-fixes).
- drm/amdgpu/uvd3.1: Fix checking whether UVD firmware keyselect was already set (git-fixes).
